verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ וְהִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י אַחַ֖ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ גִּזֵּ֥י עֲל֣וֹת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת וְהִ֨נֵּה־ לֶ֔קֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hir·’a·nî wə·hin·nêh yō·w·ṣêr gō·ḇay ’a·ḥar ham·me·leḵ giz·zê ‘ă·lō·wṯ hal·lā·qeš biṯ·ḥil·laṯ wə·hin·nêh- le·qeš
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD showed me . . . He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest as the late spring crop . . . was coming up - -

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽאֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ נָ֔א סְֽלַֽח־ מִ֥י יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב יָק֖וּם כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ קָטֹ֖ן
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- kil·lāh le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl ’eṯ- ‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh nā sə·laḥ- mî ya·‘ă·qōḇ yā·qūm kî hū qā·ṭōn
verses.literal: And when the locusts had eaten - every green plant in the land I said Lord GOD please forgive How will Jacob survive since he is so small

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה נִחַ֥ם עַל־ זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃ אָמַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ni·ḥam ‘al- zōṯ lō ṯih·yeh Yah·weh ’ā·mar
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from this [plan] It will not happen [He] said

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה קֹרֵ֛א לָרִ֥ב בָּאֵ֖שׁ וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ אֶת־ רַבָּ֔ה תְּה֣וֹם וְאָכְלָ֖ה אֶת־ הַחֵֽלֶק׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hir·’a·nî wə·hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh qō·rê lā·riḇ bā·’êš wat·tō·ḵal ’eṯ- rab·bāh tə·hō·wm wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leq
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD showed me . . . The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire It consumed - the great deep and devoured - the land

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ נָ֔א חֲדַל־ מִ֥י יַעֲקֹ֑ב יָק֖וּם כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ קָטֹ֖ן
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh nā ḥă·ḏal- mî ya·‘ă·qōḇ yā·qūm kî hū qā·ṭōn
verses.literal: Then I said Lord GOD please stop How will Jacob survive since he is so small

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה נִחַ֥ם עַל־ זֹ֑את הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה גַּם־ אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ni·ḥam ‘al- zōṯ hî lō ṯih·yeh gam- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from this [plan] It will not happen either said the Lord GOD

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔נִי וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ אֲנָֽךְ׃ וּבְיָד֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: kōh hir·’a·nî wə·hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ḥō·w·maṯ ’ă·nāḵ ’ă·nāḵ ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: This is what He showed me Behold the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb with a plumb line in His hand

verses.original: עָמ֔וֹס מָֽה־ אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֲנָ֑ךְ וָאֹמַ֖ר הִנְנִ֨י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·mō·ws māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’ă·nāḵ wā·’ō·mar hin·nî way·yō·mer ’ă·ḏō·nāy śām ’ă·nāḵ bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl lō- ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ ‘ă·ḇō·wr lōw
verses.literal: Amos what do you see asked the LORD . . . A plumb line I replied Behold said the Lord I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel I will no longer . . . spare them

verses.original: בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ וּמִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְקַמְתִּ֛י עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃פ
verses.transliteration: bā·mō·wṯ yiś·ḥāq wə·nā·šam·mū ū·miq·də·šê yiś·rā·’êl ye·ḥĕ·rā·ḇū wə·qam·tî ‘al- bêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: The high places of Isaac will be deserted and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword

verses.original: אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־ יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר עָמ֗וֹס קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹא־ תוּכַ֣ל לְהָכִ֖יל אֶת־ כָּל־ דְּבָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·maṣ·yāh kō·hên bêṯ- ’êl way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ‘ā·mō·ws qā·šar ‘ā·le·ḵā bə·qe·reḇ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hā·’ā·reṣ lō- ṯū·ḵal lə·hā·ḵîl ’eṯ- kāl- də·ḇā·rāw
verses.literal: Then Amaziah the priest vvv of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel saying Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel The land cannot . . . bear - all his words

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ עָמ֔וֹס אָמַ֣ר יָרָבְעָ֑ם יָמ֣וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ‘ā·mō·ws ’ā·mar yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām yā·mūṯ ba·ḥe·reḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: for this is what Amos has said Jeroboam will die by the sword and Israel will surely go into exile . . . away from their homeland

verses.original: אֲמַצְיָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ עָמ֔וֹס לֵ֥ךְ חֹזֶ֕ה בְּרַח־ לְךָ֖ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶאֱכָל־ לֶ֔חֶם וְשָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא׃ שָׁ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·maṣ·yāh way·yō·mer ’el- ‘ā·mō·ws lêḵ ḥō·zeh bə·raḥ- lə·ḵā ’el- ’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh we·’ĕ·ḵāl- le·ḥem wə·šām tin·nā·ḇê šām
verses.literal: And Amaziah said to Amos Go away you seer Flee to the land of Judah earn your bread . . . there and do your prophesying there

verses.original: לֹֽא־ לְהִנָּבֵ֑א וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד כִּ֤י ה֔וּא מִקְדַּשׁ־ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וּבֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- lə·hin·nā·ḇê ū·ḇêṯ- ’êl ṯō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ kî hū miq·daš- me·leḵ ū·ḇêṯ mam·lā·ḵāh hū
verses.literal: But never prophesy vvv at Bethel again . . . because it [is] the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom

verses.original: אָנֹ֔כִי וְלֹ֥א לֹא־ נָבִ֣יא עָמוֹס֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ וַיַּ֤עַן אֲמַצְיָ֔ה בֶן־ נָבִ֖יא כִּֽי־ אָנֹ֑כִי בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּבוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·lō lō- nā·ḇî ‘ā·mō·ws way·yō·mer ’el- way·ya·‘an ’ă·maṣ·yāh ḇen- nā·ḇî kî- ’ā·nō·ḵî ḇō·w·qêr ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·ḇō·w·lês šiq·mîm
verses.literal: I . . . was not a prophet Amos replied - [nor was I] the son of a prophet rather I was a herdsman [and] a tender of sycamore-fig trees

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּקָּחֵ֣נִי מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yiq·qā·ḥê·nî mê·’a·ḥă·rê haṣ·ṣōn way·yō·mer ’ê·lay Yah·weh lêḵ hin·nā·ḇê ’el- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me . . . Go prophesy to My people Israel

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’at·tāh ’ō·mêr lō ṯin·nā·ḇê ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ṯaṭ·ṭîp̄ ‘al- bêṯ yiś·ḥāq
verses.literal: Now, therefore hear the word of the LORD You say Do not prophesy against Israel do not preach against the house of Isaac

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר אִשְׁתְּךָ֞ תִּזְנֶה֙ בָּעִ֤יר וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ יִפֹּ֔לוּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב וְאַדְמָתְךָ֖ תְּחֻלָּ֑ק בַּחֶ֣בֶל וְאַתָּ֗ה תָּמ֔וּת עַל־ טְמֵאָה֙ אֲדָמָ֤ה וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’iš·tə·ḵā tiz·neh bā·‘îr ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā yip·pō·lū ba·ḥe·reḇ wə·’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā tə·ḥul·lāq ba·ḥe·ḇel wə·’at·tāh tā·mūṯ ‘al- ṭə·mê·’āh ’ă·ḏā·māh wə·yiś·rā·’êl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Your wife will become a prostitute in the city and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword Your land will be divided by a measuring line and you yourself will die on pagan soil And Israel will surely go into exile . . . away from their homeland
